verification = []
for song in target_songs:
    sid = song["song_id"]
    reviews = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=sid, user_email="brenda.webe@gmail.com", page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        reviews.extend(page)
        if len(page) < 20:
            break
        page_index += 1
    verification.append((sid, [(r["song_review_id"], r["rating"]) for r in reviews]))
print(verification)
